description: Canonical record of every DBC PoolConfig key that exists on mainnet for Seek Uplift (TB-D-1). Consumers (backend env, app featured/production manifests, external agent skill) vendor or compare against this file; `npm run verify:config-record` re-reads every key at finalized commitment and fails on drift. Add a key here BEFORE wiring it anywhere (deployment-plan.md step 9). Roles are as deployed, not as older docs stated.
